title: How to Trust: Part 2
fullTitle: Soul Snack #48: How to Trust: Part 2
description: Learn how to connect with your intuition every day. Click here to start your journey to authentic power!

Trust isn’t just about believing in people or circumstances – it’s about recognizing that everything you experience, without exception, is here to support your spiritual growth. In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav takes the conversation from How To Trust: Part 1 even deeper, exploring how trust works within the “Earth School” of life, where every event is a lesson and every emotion is an opportunity to choose between love and fear.
Through practical wisdom, Gary explains how frightened parts of our personality are driven by fear – trying to control the outside world to feel safe, valuable, or in control.

But real trust begins when you see beyond these illusions and act from a loving part of your personality, even when fear is active. This is the gateway to authentic power: living intentionally, aligned with your soul, and seeing life as a constant opportunity to grow.

The essence of trust isn’t passive faith – it’s an active, daily practice of emotional awareness, responsible choice, and love. And when you live this way, you realize that no matter what happens, it’s exactly what you need for your soul’s evolution.

chapters.title: Two Worlds, One Choice:
chapters.text: Gary describes the shift in human consciousness and how you can choose to live in gratitude, patience, and awe – or in anger, fear, and despair.

chapters.title: How the Earth School Works:
chapters.text: Learn why everything you experience is a lesson for your spiritual development and a chance to choose love over fear.

chapters.title: Fear’s One Intention:
chapters.text: Discover how all frightened parts of your personality share the same intention: to change the external world to avoid inner pain.

chapters.title: The Roller Coaster of Emotional Reactivity:
chapters.text: Gary explains how highs and lows are created when we react to life’s events without awareness – and how to step off the ride.

chapters.title: Recognizing Energy Frequencies:
chapters.text: Understand the difference between low-frequency fear-based energies and high-frequency loving energies – and why your choice matters.

chapters.title: What You Can Truly Trust:
chapters.text: Gary shares the ultimate truth: everything in your life serves your soul’s growth, and your role is to align with the right intention, appropriate timing, and trust.

outro: Reflect on a recent moment when you felt reactive or anxious. What fear-based intention was driving your response? This week, when you notice fear or judgment, pause. Ask yourself: “What would love do right now?” Then act from your loving part, trusting that this moment is here for your spiritual growth.
